cover.report_type: YEAR-END REPORT: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: ZERO-GLYPH RULING APPLIED, as the ruling requires: Summary lines 1, 2, 4 and 6 Column A each carry a SLASHED ZERO drawn as a long horizontal stroke through an oval - a glyph DENOTING zero, so 0, with the glyph recorded here. They are not dashes and not empty cells. The two schedule grand-total cells carry a plain handwritten '0'. || SUPERSCRIPT CENTS: this filer writes the cents raised above the rule on every figure ('30,371' with a superscript '62'; '6883' with a superscript '76'); those are transcribed with a decimal point per the currency convention. || total_expenditures_to_date is graded LOW: at 600 dpi the digit group reads '23182' with a superscript '86' and NO thousands comma (unlike line 1, which does carry one), and the fourth and fifth digits are cramped. '23182.86' is the best reading; there is no arithmetic on this filing that can settle it, because Column B is an aggregate with nothing to check it against, so it is left at low confidence rather than promoted. || The chunk file's candidate / office / seat / date / reporting_period all agree with the form. The cover title prints '2020 Financial Disclosure Report' and the report is a year-end signed 1-31-21 - form_year '2020' is the printed title verbatim, NOT the cycle. || The YEAR-END box carries a check drawn across it; NEITHER amendment box (Yes nor No) is ticked, so is_amendment is blank, never guessed. || PRIVACY: the cover street-address row and the phone/fax/email row are both black-barred at source, as is the signature line; nothing was recovered from them. || Note for a reader comparing filers: this is an EMPTY-PERIOD filing whose Column B is large ($30,371.62 raised to date). Empty itemized here means the schedules were looked at and are blank - never 'no donors ever'.

contributions.detail: A REAL ZERO, not a gap. The county Schedule A grid on p3 is present and wholly empty across all 15 ruled data rows, struck through corner-to-corner with a single diagonal pencil line (the filer's own 'nothing to report' mark), SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE left blank, and TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED carrying a handwritten '0'. Summary line 1 Column A carries a slashed zero and line 4 the same, so the period figure is 0 by the zero-glyph ruling. Zero rows emitted, zero stated: exact.

expenditures.detail: Same shape on p4: the Schedule B grid is present, wholly empty across its 14 ruled data rows, struck through with one diagonal pencil line, SUBTOTAL blank, TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE carrying a handwritten '0'; Summary line 2 Column A and line 6 both carry a slashed zero. A real zero.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO page-subtotal gate is available on either schedule - both SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE cells are printed and LEFT BLANK. The gate used instead is each schedule's own printed grand-total cell ('0' on both), which agrees with the Summary Column A figures and with the zero rows transcribed.
itemized.escalation_note: p2 Column-B cells for lines 1 and 2 re-rendered as a 600 dpi crop (x=3000,y=1750,W=1900,H=1000) - the cents on both are written as a raised superscript over the rule and the line-2 digit group is cramped.
